## How the guide defines it

Not addressed in guide.

## How the guide uses it

The inverse of the carousel, and mechanised on pp. 40–44 as Stability Scores. Houston's score of 18 is cited as one of only two such profiles nationally; Missouri State's zero is cited as a reason to bet the Under. Texas A&M's case rests on the same head coach and offensive coordinator returning together.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

How much of a coaching staff — head coach, coordinators, and by extension scheme — is unchanged from the previous season.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

The guide's position is that continuity compounds. A returning quarterback is worth more under a returning coordinator, which is why Dustin Swedelson flags Conner Weigman returning to the same coordinator for the first time in his career as a distinct reason to bet Houston.

## How bettors use it in this guide

As a score with thresholds, and as prose about who stayed. Coordinator continuity and play-calling continuity are held as separate concepts throughout the library, because the difference between them is useful and the guide sometimes prints them differently.

## Where it appears

pp. 40–44 for the Stability Scores; pp. 22–27 for their application; the Coaching Database for the per-team matrix.
